purpose: Teach: 議長/座長/委任/定額/賃貸/図面/法制/県知事

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学会の、本気で、絶対、議長、絶対、として、絶対、活躍しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — I need you to take the conference chair role seriously. This is important. Really commit to it.
lines.style: Direct but not unkind. Firm weight on the key demand. Pause before the final push. Voice carries quiet expectation, not doubt.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究発表会、本気で、絶対、座長、絶対、教授、絶対、お引き受けくださいました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm genuinely grateful the professor accepted the chair position for the research presentation conference.
lines.style: Respectful but grounded. Not effusive — earnest gratitude that knows its place. Steady eye contact implied, slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究室の、本気で、絶対、委任、絶対、状、絶対、お前が、絶対、整えろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And I need you to get the lab's proxy paperwork in order. This matters.
lines.style: Clipped, purposeful. Each clause lands cleanly. The tone of someone delegating to someone he trusts. No room for misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会、本気で、絶対、定額、絶対、参加費、絶対、で、絶対、お得です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The conference registration fee is actually a good deal at that flat rate. I'm really thankful for that.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact appreciation. Not celebrating, just noting — the voice of someone processing practical details. Quiet acknowledgment woven through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究室の、本気で、絶対、賃貸、絶対、契約、絶対、確認しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make sure you verify the lab's rental contract. Don't let that slip.
lines.style: Harder edge this time. Not angry, but the voice of someone who's seen mistakes happen. Brief, pointed. Expectation hardened into requirement.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験装置の、本気で、絶対、図面、絶対、教授と、絶対、確認しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've already gone over the experimental equipment blueprints with the professor. Everything's confirmed.
lines.style: Methodical confidence. Each task checked off. Voice has the steadiness of someone who's done the work. Factual, not boastful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究の、本気for、絶対、法制、絶対、面、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱え、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The research needs to address the regulatory framework in the paper. Make sure that's handled properly.
lines.style: Final instruction, measured. The voice settling into what matters most. Expectation stated without urgency — this is assumed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。県知事、本気で、絶対、表敬で、絶対、私も、絶対、随行いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'll be accompanying the prefectural governor on the courtesy visit as well. I'm grateful for the opportunity.
lines.style: Professional close. Steady, assured — the voice of someone who's stepped up and knows it. Slight formality, genuine respect underneath.
